_comment: Fuzzy knowledge base (Chapitre III, fuzzy sets / fuzzy controller). Linguistic variables with triangular ('tri': [a,b,c]) and trapezoidal ('trap': [a,b,c,d]) membership functions. The three INPUT variables form Ruspini partitions of their domain (mu_Low+mu_Medium+mu_High = 1 everywhere); the OUTPUT variable has four overlapping terms (Low, Medium, High, VeryHigh) so that full excellence can be distinguished from plain high suitability. Inference: Mamdani, AND = min, aggregation = max, defuzzification = centroid. Each major reuses the SAME rule base through an input mapping: 'core' = the major's key subject grade, 'skill' = the supporting skill grade, 'interest' = declared interest for that major. Missing interest is imputed with the neutral value 5.0 (full Medium membership).

AI.comment: AI relies on mathematics (core) and algorithmics (skill)

SE.comment: SE relies on programming (core) and algorithmics (skill)

CYB.comment: Cybersecurity relies on networks (core) and programming (skill)

imputation.comment: Neutral imputation for missing inputs: interest=5.0 gives full membership in Medium; grade=10.0 is the pass mark. Every imputation is flagged in the output trace.

rules.text: IF Core is High AND Skill is High THEN Suitability is High
IF Core is High AND Interest is High THEN Suitability is High
IF Core is Medium AND Skill is Medium THEN Suitability is Medium
IF Skill is High AND Interest is Medium THEN Suitability is High (example given in the TP statement)
IF Core is Low THEN Suitability is Low
IF Skill is Low AND Interest is Low THEN Suitability is Low
IF Core is Medium AND Interest is High THEN Suitability is Medium
IF Core is High AND Skill is Low THEN Suitability is Medium
IF Core is Low AND Skill is High THEN Suitability is Low (talent cannot compensate a failing core subject)
IF Core is High AND Interest is Low THEN Suitability is Medium (good grades partly compensate low motivation)
IF Interest is Low AND Skill is High THEN Suitability is Low (without motivation, strong skills are not enough)
IF Core is Medium AND Skill is Low THEN Suitability is Low
IF Core is High AND Skill is High AND Interest is High THEN Suitability is VeryHigh (excellence on all three dimensions)
